programme.title: The Past and the Curious
programme.desc: S9E4: Cees inspects a raffle ticket issued in the days following the Halifax Explosion. Rebecca uncovers a Victorian-era silver spoon caddy. Garth examines a set of early cameras passed down through one family.

programme.title: Reel Weddings
programme.desc: S3E13: We reminisce with Meagan and Matt about their time as summer camp councillors where they met and fell in love. See how their enthusiasm and adventurous spirits helped guide their relationship full of laughs, love and fun.

programme.title: East Coast Music Unplugged
programme.desc: S13E4 Host Darrin Harvey interviews some of the best musicians from the East Coast Music Industry. On this week's show Darrin sits down with guitar virtuoso, Connor Fox.

programme.title: Podium TV Atlantic
programme.desc: S03E04: Part 2 of the 2026 Sackville Sports Wall of Fame Induction.

programme.title: Pride Space
programme.desc: S2E1: Emily meets Veronica with Rainbow Coast Volleyball and connects with players from this vibrant queer volleyball league in Halifax, NS.

programme.title: Home Shores
programme.desc: S2E4: We visit a home overlooking the Chester Basin, perfect for hosting friends, or having a relaxing time alone! We also visit a couple who can always look out to the horizon from their antique-filled seaside home.

programme.title: GeneratioNS
programme.desc: S3E4: Lance takes a trip to Cape Breton and goes down memory lane with Pam Parris, soaking in the history that made Whitney Pier.

programme.title: Cape Breton Connects
programme.desc: S03/E05: Visit Marconi Wireless Station in Table Head, site of the first exchange of radio messages across the Atlantic Ocean. Plus, Search and Rescue efforts on the island and serving the community with the Breton Sikh Association.

programme.title: Doggy DNA
programme.desc: S5E4: We meet Artie, who came from a crowded start, but he has found his place with his people, Mazie, a puppy who acted independent from the start, and Keno, a tiny athlete with a champion past.

programme.title: Mi'kma'ki
programme.desc: S3E1: Indigenous tourism is an opportunity for education, Reconciliation and the economy. We learn about this valuable industry by speaking with Nova Scotia Indigenous Tourism Enterprise Network (NSITEN) representatives.

programme.title: The Final Draft
programme.desc: S7E13: Aaron Babcock is a graphic designer and the author of the award-winning Christian fiction The Erne Warder, released in 2023.

programme.title: Wild Nova Scotia
programme.desc: S1E13: The St. Mary's River Watershed is home to some very special habitats and species. In this episode, learn about what wildlife has been protected and what remains at risk in this pristine watershed.

programme.title: Showing Up with Nancy Regan
programme.desc: E3E4: Nancy gets her hands dirty with Ivan Higgins, creating a concrete sculpture of her own. Along the way, Ivan reveals more about his drawings, his process and the ideas hiding behind his incredible creations.

programme.title: Eastlink Magazine
programme.desc: S22E05: Meet a girl who caught a record-breaking tuna fish, Cape Breton has a pro rodeo for the first time, and learn about how you can support the SPCA with dog walking.

programme.title: Podium TV Atlantic
programme.desc: S03E04: Part 2 of the 2026 Sackville Sports Wall of Fame Induction.

programme.title: Strong After 50
programme.desc: Strong After 50, where we don't slow down with age, we train for life! Join host Elaine Muise, also known as ItFitzElaine, as she takes you through simple fitness techniques for those 50+ that you can do right at home.

programme.title: Northwood Broadcasting Club
programme.desc: Northwood Broadcasting Club.

programme.title: Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: S4E1: Amy is at BB's Bake Escape in Halifax for cookies and cinnamon rolls.

programme.title: Cuisine in the Country
programme.desc: Chef Devon Deschamps is at the Eastlink Centre in the cooking classroom, and he shows viewers how to make pan-seared skin-on chicken with cauliflower curry, basmati rice and a green onion garnish.

programme.title: Destination Dartmouth
programme.desc: S10E04: Gloria chats with Tim Rissesco, Chief Executive Officer of the Downtown Dartmouth Business Association. They chat about the past, present and future of the Downtown Dartmouth area.

programme.title: In Session
